items.title: ICF International (ICFI) Lands $35 Million Energy Efficiency Contract
items.summary: ICF International (NasdaqGS: ICFI) secured a new US$35 million contract with Entergy Louisiana, LLC to lead the utility's energy efficiency portfolio. The long term agreement covers a comprehensive set of programs focused on grid reliability and customer cost savings. The contract reinforces ICF International's role in large scale energy efficiency and utility program delivery.
